name: GothCon
blurb: Sweden's leading tabletop convention, running since the 1970s over Easter weekend in Gothenburg with board, role-playing and card games.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: '26 - 28 mars 2027' and 'När: Påskhelgen, 26 – 28 mars 2027 Var: Hvitfeldtska gymnasiet, centrala Göteborg'.

notes: Grassroots volunteer-run tabletop convention (board games, RPGs, miniatures, card games) organized by Föreningen GothCon; its program is player-submitted game sessions, not a celebrity guest lineup — found no guest/GoH page on the site or in WebSearch, so guests is 'none' rather than 'none-yet'. No og:image on the page; used the full wordmark logo (logo:1) for the cover since the available hero photos are generic activity/attendee photos from past years, which RESEARCH.md says to avoid.
